title: Raking Light
description: Three badges made from real album covers, laid on pale cotton with one lamp in your hand: Revolver as a hard enamel pin with raised black nickel lines over white enamel, Magical Mystery Tour as a rectangular embroidered patch, and Sgt. Pepper as a round patch with a gold merrowed edge. Each patch is stitched from a thread palette pulled from its cover, every colour region in its own stitch direction with satin outlines. Move the lamp and the light rakes across them; lower it to make the relief stand up.
intent: One light finished to the edge on believable merch: a real point lamp grazing height fields built from the covers themselves, with cloisonné lines, per-region stitch direction, satin outlines and rolled merrow edges that come alive as the light comes down to them.
